description: Request a Typeform choice image at a specified size. The tool expects a JSON response with image metadata rather than downloading image bytes.

image_id.description: Unique ID for the image to retrieve
image_id.title: Image Id

size.description: Image size to retrieve. Options: 'default' (scaled to fit 230x230px), 'thumbnail' (cropped to 80x80px), 'supersize' (cropped to 310x233px), 'supermobile' (cropped to 238x164px), 'supersizefit' (scaled to fit 310x233px)
size.title: Size

name: get_choice_image_by_size

avg_color.description: Average color of the image in hexadecimal format
avg_color.title: Avg Color

has_alpha.description: Whether the image has an alpha channel (transparency)
has_alpha.title: Has Alpha

height.description: Height of the image in pixels
height.title: Height

media_type.description: MIME type of the image (image/gif, image/jpeg, or image/png)
media_type.title: Media Type

src.description: URL of the choice image at the requested size
src.title: Src

width.description: Width of the image in pixels
width.title: Width
